d:
Dive into the enchanting world of love with "Nazar Teri Toofan," a romantic song from the much-anticipated Merry Christmas Movie, featuring the mesmerizing duo, Katrina Kaif and Vijay Sethupathi! Let the magical composition of Pritam, the soulful voice of Papon, and the heart-touching lyrics penned by Varun Grover sweep you off your feet.
In Cinemas on Jan 12
Song Credits:
Song: Nazar Teri Toofan
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singer: Papon
Lyrics: Varun Grover
Music Director: Pritam
